title: Acoustic Control Comment Prompts
summary: This topic is dominated by survey prompt text about sharing comments with the manufacturer, with only limited evidence of an actual acoustic-control request.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly repeat a generic manufacturer-comment prompt, while one example mentions a wish for stronger acoustic control without enough context to assign sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are repeated survey-question text rather than substantive customer feedback.
The cluster mixes prompt wording with a small amount of actual acoustic-content, so a coherent product-theme summary is limited.
